mapper.insert: INSERT INTO complaint (order_id, student_user_id, stall_id, type, content, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{studentUserId}, #{stallId}, #{type}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, /* 实体字段 camelCase 由 map 下划线转驼峰自动映射 */ s.name AS stall_name, o.order_no AS order_no FROM complaint c JOIN stall s ON s.id = c.stall_id JOIN order_info o ON o.id = c.order_id WHERE c.student_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE complaint SET reply = #{reply}, reply_time = NOW(), status = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE complaint SET verdict = #{verdict}, result = #{result}, refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, admin_id = #{adminId}, status = 2 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1)
